notes.title: Update 1.1 - Waters Vale: The Great Expansion
notes.content:
To the south of the Colony lies a territory called [b]Waters Vale[/b], bathed by the vast pink oceans of Planet Lunara and rich with blue soil that nurtures a flourishing flora, including the silvery Canabim Trees and Nexara Palms, alongside species already familiar to the colonizers. In the heart of this territory, there is a small village of green-skinned Lunarians, known for being master craftsmen who work with Canabim wood and skilled navigators. However, their lives took a turn for the worse when mysterious ships began patrolling the oceans, destroying everything in sight. As a result, the Lunarians had to abandon their navigation traditions, sinking their ships loaded with precious goods that can now be found around the islands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/e9b565239122450db8a89068679ffb0853313019.png[/img]

[b]NEW CONTENT:[/b]

[list]
[*] A new territory has been added, accessible through the southern entrance of the Colony.
[*] An infinite ocean has been added, where everything is randomly and uniquely generated, making it the only region where Exotiums can be found in crates.
[*] A new area within the territory of the Colony has been added, where many Mungu fiber trees grow.
[*] A new house model has been added to the Central Computer, available in 9 different colors.
[*] New furniture items have been added and can be acquired from the merchants in the Harvest Vale to the west of the Colony.
[*] New plant pots have been included in the inventory workshop catalog.
[*] A boat equipped with a cannon has been added to the Central Computer at the Base.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/5e29721e80be9d49afa97db772685f5e1f1fee6f.gif[/img]
[*] A new machine has been added to the inventory workshop, which creates cannon ammunition.
[*] A new tree called Nexara Palm has been added, which drops fruits that can heal the player's health and straws used in recipes.
[*] Two support drones have been added: one that attacks any enemy approaching the colonizer and a collector drone that can gather distant items. These drones can be constructed at the Central Computer at the Base, though some of the required items can only be gathered from destroyed ships in the ocean.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/1337622fd2e1afdea340c92ddf6dd8398ddbe6a8.gif[/img]
[*] A pillar has been added inside the mines, allowing colonizers to start mining at a random level between 21 and 71. To activate it, an ancestral map is required, which can only be found in lost treasure crates in the ocean.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/721f3e5fceb759b2d66b9558c43511c3583111a1.gif[/img]
[*] Two ancestral portals have been added, allowing the colonizer to teleport directly to the villages of each region. They can be crafted in the Dimensional Fold Room, with one of the necessary items found only by destroying ships in the ocean. The Dimensional Fold Room is unlocked by fitting 8 hidden cores from the Ancestral Labyrinth.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/2d2dc1f1a09d7a687613d412ad4bc1fc8b9e43d5.gif[/img]
[*] A new ore known as Vendalite has been added, appearing rarely from level 50 of the Mines. It is highly resistant and drops Rift Powder, a key material for ancestral batteries used in the construction of drones and portals, and is also highly valuable to the Valencia merchant.
[*] A Titanium Ingot has been added, used in the construction of various objects, such as the boat, drones, and more.
[/list]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]

[list]
[*] It is now possible to check the level you are on in the Mines.
[*] The Merchant now appears almost every day, except on rainy days or during snowstorms.
[*] Construction recipes have been updated to use planks, cement, sand, and bricks instead of logs and stones.
[*] The drop rate for items from Mungu Fiber Trees, Exosulfur Ores, and Sandstones has been significantly increased.
[*] The size of collected items has been reduced by 30%.
[*] The colony map interface has received a visual upgrade.
[*] Animal hides from the two valleys now have a use; additionally, the damage and defense of these animals have been reduced, and the amount of hide collected from them has been increased.
[*] The decorative item merchant in the Harvest Valley now requires specific items instead of just Exotiums.
[*] Several objects have received improvements in their artwork, along with other minor visual enhancements.
[/list]

[b]FIXED ERRORS:[/b]

[list]
[*] Some items, such as the Junino shelf, had their IDs swapped, causing other items to appear in their place.
[*] An error was found in the base PC constructions.
[*] Several translation errors have been corrected.
[*] An unwanted screen appeared when crafting plant pots in the workshop.
[*] Some items did not have the correct crafting recipes.
[*] A fix was implemented for the issue where boxes were not being picked up with the control.
[/list]

[b]FUTURE OF THE GAME:[/b]

For the next update, I plan to focus on expanding the existing content before creating a new territory. This will include the development of 10 additional mount levels, an improved mission system, expansion of content within the ocean, and the story of Planet Lunara narrated by the colonists, along with other ideas I have in mind.

notes.title: Fixes and Oceanic Adventures Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello, adventurers of [b]Planet IX![/b] Marcos here, the solo developer of the game, bringing exciting news about fixes and upcoming content.

[list]
[*] [b]Arabic translation fix:[/b] I’ve adjusted the text display to make reading smoother and easier.
[*] [b]Ambient sound fixes:[/b] I’ve fine-tuned the ambient sounds, making the experience more immersive.
[*] [b]Climate fixes in the Vale of the Lunarians:[/b] The weather system is now more accurate and functioning properly.
[*] [b]Other small fixes:[/b] Minor bugs have been fixed, along with optimizations for better overall stability.
[/list]
I’m also thrilled to announce that the development of the new oceanic territory is well underway! Soon, you'll be able to sail through an infinite ocean in search of resources, controlling your very own boat. This new territory will also introduce a fishing system and tons of exciting new content, including:

[b][list]
[*] Decorative items
[*] New houses
[*] Unique flora and fauna
[*] A vast Canabim log forest.
[/list][/b]
The new territory is expected to launch in October, so stay tuned for more updates and get ready to embark on a fresh ocean adventure!

Thanks for all the support, and for being a part of this journey!

notes.content:
[b]Fix for Time System When Sleeping[/b]
[list]
[*] Time now advances correctly after the player sleeps, allowing for uninterrupted progress.
[/list]
[b]Fix for Clock When Transitioning Between the Colony and Other Areas[/b]
[list]
[*] We resolved the issue where the clock was forced to reset to 12 PM when returning to the Western Valley Colony or other areas. Time now flows consistently across all regions.
[/list]
[b]Increased Recovery Speed for Fauna and Flora[/b]
[list]
[*] All fauna and flora in the game now recover faster, making exploration and resource gathering more efficient.
[/list]

[list]

Please take a moment to rate the game on Steam and send me your feedback. Your support helps me continue improving the game and making it the best experience possible for everyone.

notes.title: Exciting New Update for PLANET IX: Xbox Controller Support and More!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/ab73b9f200eb3acff16bcaa21a8353b61e0710a9.jpg[/img]

I’m excited to announce a new update for [b]PLANET IX![/b] The game is now fully compatible with Xbox controllers, allowing you to play with increased comfort and flexibility. With this new feature, you can activate the Xbox controller simply by pressing the A button in-game. To switch back to keyboard and mouse, just press the left mouse button. Additionally, you can adjust the sensitivity of the right analog stick in the inventory settings for a personalized experience.

[b]Other improvements in this update include:[/b]

[list]
[*][b] Expanded Impact Area:[/b] The impact area when using the pickaxe or axe has been increased to make it easier to gather minerals and wood.
[*] [b]Resistance and Probability Adjustments:[/b] Stone resistance has been reduced by 30%, and the likelihood of finding valuable ores in the mines has been increased. Gold ore now has double the chance to drop precious stones like diamonds, alexandrite, ruby, and sapphire. These precious stones can be used at the Forge in the Harvest Vale to craft better weapons and tools, and are also essential for unlocking the entrance to the [b]Ancient Labyrinth.[/b]
[*] [b]Important Fixes:[/b] Resolved issues with the warehouse that caused item duplication or loss. Additionally, other minor fixes have been made to improve the gameplay experience.
[/list]

[b]Next Steps:[/b] I am beginning work on the maritime content for the game, which will be accessible via the bridge south of the colony. This new content will allow you to build a ship to explore the “7 seas” of Planet IX and will be available from the start of the game.

I greatly appreciate the ongoing support from all players. Your feedback is crucial for improving the game. Please leave a review on Steam and share your thoughts!

Thank you and enjoy exploring the new features and improvements!

notes.title: Today's Updates in Planet IX: Important Fixes and Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/6884496b6860459befe044a3c0bb0bc967cd66fb.png[/img]

Hello, Planet IX adventurers!

Today, I’m bringing several important updates to improve your gameplay experience:

[list]
[*] [b]Item ID Fixes:[/b] Some item IDs were accidentally swapped, causing incorrect items to appear when placed. After reviewing over 400 decorative and functional items, I have corrected all errors, ensuring items now display correctly.

[*] [b]Camera Improvements for Large Constructions:[/b] For large structures such as power plants, schools, and hospitals, I have added camera zoom functionality during the placement mode to ensure these structures are fully visible on the player’s screen.

[*] [b]Joystick Configuration:[/b] I have begun configuring the joystick, which is partially complete. Currently, I’m focusing on mouse cursor movement with the analog stick. I believe this will be ready soon. I am using an Xbox Series S joystick and plan to acquire additional joysticks and a second notebook with future sales to implement cooperative mode.
[/list]

I deeply appreciate the continuous feedback from all of you. Your reviews on Steam are crucial to highlighting the game.

Thank you very much, and I hope you have a great gaming experience!

— Marcos

notes.title: Save Update and Game Improvements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45129068/c7165929b7080f1b8f5a9a6c9b195ee555c2f9c2.png[/img]

After receiving reports from players experiencing issues with the save system, I quickly worked to address the situation. However, I couldn’t immediately identify the problem because the save files were automatically generated by the Unity Engine itself, which required testing on a second computer—something I don't yet have, but it is one of the main investments planned with the game's sales.

Given the lack of satisfactory results, I decided to completely overhaul the save system and take the opportunity to eventually add cloud save functionality. I'm still working on this update but wanted to ensure players have a more stable experience as quickly as possible. I apologize to everyone who was affected by this issue and strongly recommend starting a new save, as current saves may be corrupted and cause game errors. Once again, I sincerely apologize and promise to keep working to make the game better.

Currently, the game saves in several ways: when transitioning between areas, when sleeping, every in-game hour, and when the player clicks "Exit" or "Return to Main Menu."

Additionally, based on player feedback, I've made some improvements:

[list]
[*] Now, when the character is behind trees, they become 50% transparent, allowing the player to see what’s behind.
[*] Added a button in the settings to turn screen shake on or off.
[*] Reduced the maximum volume of footstep sounds, and now you can adjust sound volumes in the settings.
[*] Increased oxygen healing inside the base.
[*] Fixed some bugs reported by players.
[/list]
I would like to ask everyone to rate the game on Steam, as it will help increase its reach and visibility. After ensuring the game is free of any major bugs, I will begin working on new maritime content, including an ocean full of challenges to explore.

Thank you for your patience and continued support! I will keep listening to community feedback to improve the game even further.
